name: Hinomori Kohaku
source:
The head of the Hinomori family. A major landowner whose name is synonymous with the land itself. Her husband is an adopted son-in-law and is currently on a business trip overseas.

She is a hard-to-approach, dignified woman, but she approaches  [url=/c156628]Masaaki[/url] with abnormally sensual physical contact.

For some reason, she suggests a game to wipe away Masaaki's debt.

She is in her late 30s.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343034]Getchu[/url]]
